problems.reason: Both sentences state the same speculation that Caenagnathasia lived near the time when Caenagnathidae and Oviraptoridae separated.
Sentence 1 estimates a skull length of ~7.6 cm, while sentence 4 estimates the whole animal was ~2 ft (≈61 cm) long – incompatible size estimates.
Both sentences state that Caenagnathasia is the earliest oviraptorosaur lacking teeth in the lower jaw.
